data.hypothesis: With the existing 128-target CTA, a 1536-source tile should reduce source-staging and synchronization rounds versus the current 128-source tile while retaining one thread per target and the same force arithmetic. The four shared arrays use 24,576 bytes, within the 49,152-byte limit; controller timing must determine whether this reuse outweighs staging cost.
data.notes: The launch remains block=128 and items_per_block=128; launch.json needs no change. Partial source tiles are zero-filled, target tails remain guarded, and self-interactions remain excluded. No correctness or performance result is claimed for this candidate. The prior valid 1536/256 result is related context, not a measurement of this 1536/128 configuration; use the official full-correctness and per-size geometric-mean protocol.
transformations: Increase the static source tile from 128 to 1536 entries; cooperatively load it in strides of blockDim.x, zero-fill the partial tail, and keep all target, force-arithmetic, and self-interaction logic unchanged.
